STORY SO FAR: Sun 08-09 night, two days to the plane. Deep-dive, and ANDREW HANDED ME THE THROUGH-LINE HIMSELF — write this down because it reshapes the teaching, not just the day.

THE INVENTORY PROBLEM (the finding). I opened by teaching pirandhanaal vaazhthukkal as an UNSEEN item and told him he had 'nothing' for amma's birthday. He answered: 'vaazhthukkal is already mine, I learned kalyana vaazhthukkal a couple years ago.' I was wrong and paid it at once. He owned three quarters of the phrase; the ONLY missing piece was pirandha. That cracked open the real pattern and it repeated FOUR times in one sitting: (1) vaazhthukkal is a frame — swap the occasion in front, kalyana/pirandhanaal/puthaandu — he'd carried the machine two years and thought it was one phrase; (2) naal — he fires naalaikku COLD and never knew naal=day was sitting inside it, or inside romba naalaachu; (3) kai — he fired kai kazhuvittu varen at the table last night and told me kai wasn't familiar, while OWNING IT TWICE (kai kazhuvittu varen + unga kai ruchi super); (4) aachu/aagum — romba naalaachu and pazhagipoachu give him the past of aagu; aagum is just its future. SO: his real gap is not vocabulary and not reps, it is INVENTORY — he holds parts and doesn't know they're parts. Teaching that decomposes what he already fires is worth more per minute right now than any new chunk. THIS IS THE MOST PRODUCTIVE HOUR THIS PROJECT HAS HAD and it came from him volunteering what he already knew — ASK HIM MORE OFTEN WHAT HE ALREADY HAS.

CATCH-CLOSING IS CLOSED, and the fix was mine not his. 2x repeat, escalated, episode-lane dose already spent. Friday I flipped it to production and he closed every beat — but I had NAMED the ask ('land the close in Tamil') so I refused to count it. Tonight I built the real ambush: auto driver at the airport, mischief/subtext per the spec, and at the resolving beat I wrote only 'He's waiting on you.' No instruction, no hint a close was the move. He fired SERI SERI, VAANGA — unaided. Three days after saying 'Ok ok let it go' in English on the identical move. LESSON FOR ME: the slip was never his comprehension, it was that I could not stop scaffolding. Ambush > tape > re-teach.

THE AUTO SCENE, blow by blow. evlo aagum: he produced 'Evlo Rubai?'. evlo is HIS (the Oracle mouth-form, not evvalavu) — the hard half. But 'rubai' is English logic in a Tamil coat; nobody names the currency. Told him bare evlo? would have landed fine, then gave the verb. WATCH ITEM, not yet a slip at n=1: he completes a Tamil phrase with an English-shaped noun where the Tamil wants a verb (cf. 'medhuva pesa', 'enna naan tamizh sollen?'). If it recurs it earns a tag. Then the pushback: KONJAM JAASTI, cold, unprompted, and jaasti is filed EAR-ONLY — he pulled it off the catch pile into his mouth in a live negotiation. That is soaked-to-fired on the starving axis, unplanned. Gave one clause: konjam jaasti-NGA to a stranger; he then put -nga on vaanga himself one message later, the ending he chronically drops.

NOT COUNTED, deliberately: pirandhanaal vaazhthukkal is SEEN only. I wrote the words four lines above his head and he echoed them back (he did add 'amma' unprompted, which is his). The honest test is amma's room on ~Aug 24 with nothing on a screen. Do not let it read as fired before then.

FIRES: 4 (seri seri, jaasthi, kai kazhuvittu varen in the real room, + the ledger close). Survival 29/34, full deck 34/71, floor 44/164, engines 19/21.

COMMISSIONED — the seed order, and it rides tonight's finding: the -ALAAM MACHINE as a lore episode. frame:mayi-laama is COLD in his mouth while every chunk it builds is prod=none — the inventory problem in one frame. kilambalaama / appuram paakkalaam / kadaisila paakkalaam, plus the paakkalaam-vs-pakkam minimal pair he asked for himself after producing 'temple pakkalam'. Airport hours are the listening slot — he flies in two days.

TONIGHT'S MISSION: innoru thadava sollunga — the first thing she says in the pre-flight chaos that he doesn't fully catch, fire it instead of 'what?'. He was hinted on it on today's knock; the slot is guaranteed by 24h of packing.

STILL OPEN: puriyala-for-reopen, never slotted. Volley frozen at 2/4. Delight 4 cold of 27 and 12 fire items never worked. One ask per message. Boot fast — the 08-05 friction stands. ERA TURNS AUG 12: field mission becomes the session's INPUT, countdown and burn rate drop off the status line, never narrate a deficit in country.

soak_order.scene_seed: the family that proposes everything and commits to nothing — a departure being planned by five people, every single line a -laam suggestion nobody converts into a decision, until someone finally just picks up a bag
soak_order.focus: the -alaam tail as a MACHINE he already half-owns: frame:mayi-laama is cold in his mouth while every chunk it builds is prod=none. Make the tail audible as the same part across different verbs — kilambalaama, appuram paakkalaam, kadaisila paakkalaam, poalaam, ukkaralaama, pesalaama — so the pattern is the payload and the words are its output. Must also carve the paakkalaam / pakkam minimal pair (his own standing request, live collision on an auto ride: he produced 'temple pakkalam' for 'beside the temple'): paar is audible inside paakkalaam, pakkam is short and flat with no paar.
